text: Implemented generic Observations, an exact ObservationFitDesign (entire table vs declared training subset), and observation-table PCA through the canonical Mvpa pipeline. PCA owns an explicit open boundary, component/preparation estimand, budgeted local materialization, exact component axis, direct Multivar PcaFit capability, typed reusable loadings/scores/singular-value queries, and fit/solver/materialization receipts. Base-R, dense/operator, no-recompute, identity, and failure courts pass on JVM+JS.
